reviews.title: Fast and Powerful Kebtek Hand Loppers
reviews.body: Amazing, time saving hand loppers! These are fast and scary powerful. MUST keep focused on what you are doing as inattention while using these could have disatorous consequences. They do have a safety feature where they can sense if your hand not holding the cutter comes into contact with the blade. It has a special procedure to turn on this feature  but is not real effective if in high humidity areas, and probably will not function if in rain. Am not sure as I have not yet used it in rain. Also that feature will not work if you are wearing gloves as it needs to be able to sense electrical contact through your skin. I need a glove on off hand as I am constantly cutting thorny brush so have found by using a leather glove with the cuff rolled up and then a chainmail (butchers) glove pulled over the leather glove with a rubberband placed on my wrist to make certain I am grounded to the outer metal chainmail glove through my wrist the safety shut off feature seems to work flawlessly. It will sometimes shut the cut off if in real wet or sappy wood and occassionally will stop a cut as it senses hand contact even when opposite or off hand is a foot or more away from the lopper. In cases like that I have learned to let go of the branch being cut, cut it first, then grab it to move it. Wearing two gloves like this gives me way more peace of mind while using this cutter as it is so fast and powerful.It also has a nice feature where you can reduce the opening size of the blades to one inch. This is handy and faster when cutting lots of smaller branches and also saves a little battery life due to the shorter duration of a smaller cut.I am WAY impressed with these as they are a HUGE timesaver and also save a LOT of work over using manual loppers.I have made right at 3500 cuts with these so far and battery is STILL at 57% of full charge!Cannot go wrong with this tool as long as you are and stay  super careful while using them!

reviews.title: Will cut anything you put in it, so watch out!
reviews.body: This is an amazing tool I didn’t know I needed! For decades I’ve used loppers just like everyone else, but got fed up with annoying wrist pain after an hour or so of cutting scrub and decided to find something better. As a man on the Makita platform, my first instinct was to look for a teal tool, but I discovered they had not released their electric pruners on the American market. Further research eventually led me to the Kebtek brand, which I was apprehensive about going with at such a steep price, but the feedback I was seeing was so enthusiastic I figured I would take the plunge. People reviewing them weren’t just happy they worked, they just couldn’t believe the results they were getting out of this no name brand. After using these for awhile now (1500 cuts, yes, it keeps track of that on the device!) I can understand that now! These shears are definitely a professional grade tool, with a quality I would’ve expected if I had been able to get my hands on the Makita equivalent.Firstly, battery life is good, can’t complain, still at 75% after an hour or two. It comes with two batteries, so I suppose if someone had to use this all day they would have enough juice. Secondly, the cutting itself is fantastic. The shears open wide to 40mm (1.575”) and it will cut ANYTHING that fits, so please be careful! This is a nice size, as anything larger is getting into reciprocating saw range anyway. What’s remarkable though is that it actually can handle whatever you can give it. We’ve all encountered manual cutting tools, whether they be loppers, scissors, etc, that simply refuse to budge if you want them to cut something that’s more than half the size of the opening. The KT940 has no such limitations, instantly going thru an inch and a half of hardened dead branch or a bundle of fresh twigs without the slightest hesitation. Hate the expression, but it’s like a knife thru butter. This might actually be a con in a way, because what happens is you’ll find yourself in a thick patch, continuously cutting deep in the scrub, and the shears are so smooth and effortless that you almost forget you’re using this beast to cut branches and you’re not holding puny scissors up to paper. I can’t fault this for doing its job so well, so again, be very cautious always when using these pruning shears!!

reviews.title: Really great tool but not certain of longevity
reviews.body: This pruner is incredibly strong and efficient...I had an earlier version that only lasted 2.5 years and I  I felt it was not very long-lived for the cost ($275.00 back then) Customer service said there were no replacement parts (bad motherboard apparently) I was very disappointed.But for me, there's just no going back to traditional, manual pruning.  The efficiency of this thing is SO good, and SO strong, I purchased my second one and am gambling on this latest model, which they said is a better build, and I am hoping this one will give me more service time.

reviews.title: KT940, would recommend
reviews.body: So far I’m pretty happy with these electric pruners.  The build quality seems really good.  The weight seems solid and sturdy without feeling heavy.  The LED screen is a nice touch.  You get two batteries which last a long time.  It can be a little tricky getting the battery off as noted by other reviews.  Being able to charge both batteries at the same time with the double sided charger is a nice feature.  If I could change two things one would be to be able to change out the steel blades for longer ones.  And the other change I would make would be an auto trigger setting.

features: Maximum Diameter of 40MM --- Kebtek KT-940 electric tree pruner max cutting diameter is 40MM which could meet your different needs for pruning different branches and trees in various occasions. Long press the trigger intercharge the cutting diameter from 40MM/1.57inch to 25MM/0.98inch.

Progressive Cutting Control --- The opening of the blade of electric pruner can be stopped at any angle, so it can be used for fine and careful pruning like hand pruner and which can achieve a safer and more detailed pruning operation.

Non-Stick Teflon Coating SK5 Blade --- The Kebtek 40MM electric pruning shears’ blade is forged from teflon SK5 high carbon steel. The blade with high hardness and good rust resistance. Support over 100000 cuts.Cut branches without hurt. The cut surface of the branch is flat and non- stick which can keep the plant healthy.

Efficient Brushless Motor --- Our Cordless electric pruner is equipped with a strong permanent magnet brushless motor. Compared with brush motor, brushless motor provides 300% more torque, more power, longer operation & extend motor life, also 50% lower energy consumption.
